topic.title: Data Types Practice
topic.description: An introduction to Python data types: strings, integers, and type conversion. Demonstrates accessing characters by index and converting between types.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Accessing individual characters in a string using index notation and converting strings to integers with int().
learningNotes.challenges: Understanding zero-based indexing for the first time.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Explore floats, booleans, and type checking.

files.description: Sum of digits using string indexing and type conversion.
